notes.title: SteamDeck Compatibility!
notes.content:
WIth the SteamDeck's recent release in Australia, we thought it was a good time for this!
[list]
[*] Move through the world with standard SteamDeck and XBox controls
[*] Use L-Stick or D-Pad to solve puzzles in an intuitive way
[*] Relax on the couch, train or airplane as you make your escape!
[/list]

notes.title: More audio bug fixes
notes.content: Minor fixes to audio files which caused issues on some systems.

notes.title: Bug fixes and Quality-of-life updates
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing ESC early no longer causes problems.
[*] Minimum audio levels fixed which may cause problems on some systems.
[/list]
[h3]Quality-of-life updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Run is now explicitly shown as [i]toggled[/i] by pressing Shift (default key binding).
[*] Settings are remembered between subsequent launches.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and Quality-of-life updates
notes.content:
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pushing ESC before the game starts no longer causes problems.
[*] Changes to minimum audio levels which potentially cause problems on some systems.
[/list]

[h3]Quality-of-life updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Running is now explicitly defined to be [i]toggled[/i] by pushing Shift (default key binding).
[*] Settings are remembered between launches of the game.
[/list]
